crossRefs.note: Blessed is he who considers the poor. Yahweh will deliver him in the day of evil.
Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.
The ways of the scoundrel are evil. He devises wicked plans to destroy the humble with lying words, even when the needy…
But the noble devises noble things; and he will continue in noble things.
The righteous perish, and no one lays it to heart. Merciful men are taken away, and no one considers that the righteous…
Isn’t it to distribute your bread to the hungry, and that you bring the poor who are cast out to your house? When you…
Therefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable to you, and break off your sins by righteousness, and your iniquities…
Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.
“For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
But if you don’t forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
Then the King will tell those on his right hand, ‘Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from…
“Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to…
Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.
Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.
He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.
For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he will not build it up.
There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his…
For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.

translations.web: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.
translations.bsb: A kind man benefits himself, but a cruel man brings trouble on himself.
translations.kjv: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.
translations.asv: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul; But he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.
